messages.content: A language model predicts the next token in a sequence. By learning which tokens tend to follow which over a large corpus, it can generate fluent text one token at a time.
You are a concise, helpful assistant.
Give me one tip for training a small GPT.
Use a modest context length and plenty of data relative to your parameter count, and watch validation loss so you stop before the model overfits.

messages.content: What does temperature do during sampling?
Temperature scales the logits before softmax. Lower values make the model more confident and repetitive; higher values make it more random and creative.
Top-p (nucleus) sampling keeps the smallest set of most-likely tokens whose probabilities sum to p, then samples from just that set. It adapts the candidate pool to the model's confidence.
